hypotheses:
Every issue reaches you through the question tool first; the study room opens only when you ask, and a question can offer that as an option. A large backlog is grouped by the principle it hinges on and asked a few at a time between tasks, a blocking question at once. Your own answers settle what they answer even before the judge approves their record. When waiting questions hinge on something you don't know yet, iaso proposes one study ahead of them. The band draws no cards and Hide stays hidden. iaso's own failures still go to the debug workflow, you last.
